metaDescription: Free online XML Formatter. Format and indent XML.
intro: Use our free online XML Formatter tool. It beautifies XML documents based on your inputs.
whatIs: The XML Formatter is an online utility that beautifies XML documents. It processes your raw XML and provides indented XML with collapsible nodes.
howToUse: Enter your raw XML into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like formatted XML.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate indented XML with collapsible nodes.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your raw XML. It instantly processes the data to output indented XML with collapsible nodes.
resultInterpretation: The result represents indented XML with collapsible nodes. You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing raw XML on the go
tipsAndLimitations: XML must have a single root node to be valid.
Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: Can it format HTML?
faq.answer: It can format strict XHTML, but might fail on loose HTML.

faq.question: Is the XML Formatter free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, our XML Formatter is completely free and requires no registration.

faq.question: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool is fully responsive and functions perfectly on all smartphones and tablets.
